title: Giant Squid
description: Simulate bingo to find the first and last boards to win.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate the bingo game by drawing numbers one at a time and tracking which boards have won. Record the first and last winners.

## Part 1

Draw numbers sequentially. For each number, mark it on all boards. After each mark, check if any row or column is complete. The first board to achieve bingo wins — its score is the sum of unmarked numbers multiplied by the winning number.

## Part 2

Continue the game past the first winner. Skip boards that have already won. The last board to complete a bingo is the answer, scored the same way. This lets the squid win by choosing the worst board.
